comment: I am interested in pursuing Political Science, but unfortunately I do not feel like this class laid the foundation I needed. The material was very similar to what I learned in International Relations, and the lectures were exactly the same as the textbook. She will frequently give extra credit, and is easy to meet with and responds to email quickly

Tuba is an awesome lady.  She is very helpful outside of class.  The class is inherently supposed to be boring and lecture based but in her WGSS seminar classes, the discussions are more fun.  I plan on taking her again.  She is pretty lenient on grading.
She is a poor teacher of an easy  class. Expect to learn everything from the textbook.

Annoying accent. Passive. Easy enough.. only 5 short papers throughout the semester, but be analytical. Class sometimes got out of hand and seemed like a sleepover with lots of dumb comments from her and the class. Tries to force her opinions on you. Bad representation of feminists.

Nicest teacher ever for sure, very knowledgeable on subject.  She knew a ton about international relations I'd never heard of.  Extremely easy class, boring in class but only because we made it that way.

Very nice person!  Somewhat passive about the material so make sure you study.  That's how you learn in this class.  Always agreeable to meet with you out of class.  Easy assignments, fair/hard grader.  Fun accent to listen to.  :-)  I recommend her, even though the class tends to be boring.
